name: Quorum reads and writes (wait for 2 of 3)
description: The data is stored 3 times (a primary and 2 replicas), as in Cassandra or DynamoDB: each read and write goes to the 3 copies at once (fan-out 3) and answers when 2 succeed (quorum 2). A write goes to each copy itself, without replication after it. From 20 s, the third copy is 20× slower. Waiting for 2 hides it: while it is slow, p99 is about 63 ms, as usual. Set "Quorum" to 0 (wait for all 3): each request waits for the slow copy, p50 goes up to about 128 ms and p99 to about 359 ms. Remove the fan-out (one copy, reads go to the replicas): half of the reads hit the slow replica, p99 about 223 ms. The copy not waited for still does its work, so the database does 3 times the work.
